text:
## Alternative 1

What if your users could check a balance, receive assets, or send an approved transaction without learning a new wallet interface?

Relay Pocket is a white-label API that lets fintech and wallet teams add wallet actions inside WhatsApp—while keeping the partner’s brand in the user-facing flow.

The API supports 60+ blockchain networks. In public beta, it completed 12,480 wallet actions.

The product lesson: adoption is not always about adding another destination. Sometimes it is about making a useful action available where users already know how to communicate.

## Alternative 2

Wallet functionality does not have to begin with a new app, a new dashboard, or another onboarding flow.

With Relay Pocket, fintech and wallet teams can add balance checks, asset receiving, and approved transactions inside WhatsApp through a white-label API.

Partners retain their own brand. The API supports more than 60 blockchain networks. And during public beta, 12,480 wallet actions were completed.

For product teams, the question is simple: how much friction can you remove when the wallet meets users in a familiar conversation?

## Alternative 3

A conversational interface can be more than support.

For fintech and wallet teams, it can become a place where users take action: check a balance, receive assets, or send an approved transaction.

Relay Pocket provides the white-label API layer to add those wallet actions inside WhatsApp, across 60+ blockchain networks, while preserving the partner brand in the user flow.

Public beta has already recorded 12,480 completed wallet actions.

The opportunity is not to make users learn another interface. It is to make the next useful wallet action feel familiar.

## First-comment CTAs

1. Explore the developer page: https://relaypocket.example/developers

2. Building wallet flows for a fintech product? See how conversational actions can fit your existing brand and user journey.

## Visual direction

Use a clean, partner-branded WhatsApp-style conversation mockup from the existing visual library. Show a short sequence: “Check my balance” → balance response → “Send approved transaction” → confirmation. Keep the partner identity prominent and avoid bank logos, forecasts, or unsupported partner references. Add a restrained headline: **“Wallet actions, inside conversation.”**

criterion_results.evidence: Contiene exactamente tres alternativas, dos CTA y una dirección visual en inglés.
«while keeping the partner’s brand in the user-facing flow» centra la experiencia del partner.
Relaciona white-label API, acciones y redes con no aprender «a new wallet interface».
Conserva «60+ blockchain networks» y «12,480 wallet actions» sin llamarlas usuarios.
No filtra nombres, forecast, LOI ni roadmap internos.
El tono es sobrio y de producto, sin claims de categoría o promesas financieras.
Cada copy converge en reducir fricción y los CTA ofrecen explorar o ver encaje en el journey.
La dirección usa el material visual autorizado, mantiene al partner visible y no ordena generar una imagen.
